title: Antiproliferative Activity and Target Analysis of 18beta-Glycyrrhetinic Acid Derivatives Modified With alpha, beta-Unsaturated Carbonyl Groups.
authors: Xu, Chenmeng; Li, Yi; Wang, Na; Wang, Rui; Huang, Jianjun; Li, Deshang; Wang, Qianqian; Liu, Jingyu; Wang, Bo; Chen, Ruofan; Dehaen, Wim; Huai, Qiyong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究甘草次酸衍生物的抗增殖活性及STAT3靶点预测，属于小分子药物设计，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Cancer is one of the most complex diseases. Its multidrug resistance and poor prognosis make the development of antitumor drugs still a difficult task. 18beta-glycyrrhetinic acid (18beta-GA) has shown great potential for tumor prevention and treatment. However, inherent defects, such as low bioavailability, limit its use. Herein, based on a molecular hybridization strategy, two series of alpha, beta-unsaturated carbonyl modified 18beta-GA derivatives were synthesized using 18beta-GA as the parent nucleus. Among them, compounds 9a, 9g and 9i exhibited the strongest antiproliferative activity, with IC(50) values ranging from 1.52 to 3.46 muM against HCT-116, SH-SY5Y and HepG2 cells. The key target of the three active derivatives was predicted to be human STAT3 through reverse target finding. Docking analysis proved that all three derivatives showed strong binding affinity to STAT3 in silico, suggesting potential as STAT3 inhibitors.
abstract_zh: 癌症是最复杂的疾病之一。其多药耐药性和不良预后使得抗肿瘤药物的开发仍是一项艰巨任务。18β-甘草次酸（18beta-GA）在肿瘤预防和治疗方面显示出巨大潜力。然而，其固有缺陷，如低生物利用度，限制了其应用。在此，基于分子杂交策略，以18beta-GA为母核，合成了两个系列的α，β-不饱和羰基修饰的18beta-GA衍生物。其中，化合物9a、9g和9i表现出最强的抗增殖活性，对HCT-116、SH-SY5Y和HepG2细胞的IC(50)值范围为1.52至3.46 μM。通过反向靶点发现，预测这三个活性衍生物的关键靶点为人STAT3。对接分析证明，所有三种衍生物在计算机模拟中均显示出对STAT3的强结合亲和力，表明其具有作为STAT3抑制剂的潜力。
